{{Short description|British mathematician}}
{{Use dmy dates|date=April 2022}}
'''Rolph Ludwig Edward Schwarzenberger''' (7 February 1936 – 29 February 1992) was a British mathematician at the [[University of Warwick]] who worked on [[vector bundle]]s (where he introduced [[jumping line]]s), [[crystallography]], and mathematics education.

He was President of the [[Mathematical Association]] in 1983–1984.
